name: Nomad
tagline: Keeps a running register of your agents so the stack is never locked in
description: This one exists so a collection of assistants never ends up stranded where it was first built. It keeps a current register of every bot you run, the skills each carries, what it plugs into, what it fires on a timer and how it is reached. Nothing secret is stored, and it works in whichever language you prefer.
author: PedroAnibarro
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
